Ishita Shah
Java Developer | Hyderabad, Telangana
ishita.shah669@example.com | +91 9102366017

Motivated Java developer focused on building resilient backend services and streaming data pipelines. Strong track record delivering production microservices and integrations, collaborating in Agile teams to meet SLAs and reduce latency. Seeking opportunities to apply Java and Kafka expertise to scalable systems.
Notice period: 90 days

Experience
Tata Consultancy Services — Jan 2025 - Present
Java Developer, Remote
- Implemented Dockerized Spring Boot microservices for a payments reconciliation platform, reducing deploy time by 45% and enabling consistent environment parity across staging and production.
- Designed and integrated Apache Kafka event streams to decouple payment ingestion and downstream processing, processing 120k events/hour with end-to-end processing latency under 1.2s.

- Collaborated in Agile sprints using Jira and Git, delivering three major releases and introducing automated health checks and container orchestration best practices.

Vertex Analytics — May 2023 - Dec 2024
Backend Engineer, Onsite

- Implemented Apache Kafka-based ETL pipelines to stream processed telemetry into analytics topics, increasing throughput from 10k to 80k messages/hour while maintaining consumer lag under acceptable thresholds.
- Containerized services with Docker and standardized build pipelines in Git, cutting integration issues by 35% and accelerating rollout of feature branches.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies, maintained Jira tickets, and wrote integration tests to ensure reliability of microservices across environments.

Projects
- Real-time Transaction Monitor — Developed a Dockerized Java microservice that consumes Kafka topics to detect anomalies in transaction streams and writes alerts to MySQL; prototype achieved 92% precision on test dataset.
- Load Simulation Toolkit — Created a Java-based tool to simulate Kafka producer/consumer workloads to validate throughput and latency for upcoming releases, used to tune broker and consumer configurations.
